title: Pluggable validation sandbox for profile generation and dataset lineage
creator: Marta Rivera
description: Problem: onboarding new model versions requires repeatedly iterating datasets, prompt variants, and runner configs in the main benchmark harness which is slow, hard to isolate, and has flaky cross-run state. Proposal: add a lightweight, pluggable validation sandbox that can spin up ephemeral eval runners, apply deterministic prompt mutation strategies, and attach lineage metadata to sampled dataset shards. The sandbox should reuse harness adapters but not mutate canonical runner state; it must support model-version pinning and allow quick publishable profile diffs for runtime consumers. This will speed profile generation, make regressions easier to triage, and reduce noise in CI clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox can be launched locally and in staging via existing harness CLI with a single --sandbox flag
Sandbox supports plugging in custom eval-runner shims without changing main harness contracts
Dataset shards produced by sandbox include lineage metadata (source dataset ID, sampling seed, filter predicates) and are stored in S3 with consistent keys
Prompt mutation module allows deterministic replay given a seed and emits a compact mutation manifest
We can produce a profile draft JSON for a pinned model-version using sandbox results and publish to the profile registry API
End-to-end smoke: a new model version pinned to profile draft reroutes in staging and produces expected perf deltas in the console dashboard
work_items: Design: define sandbox runtime contract and lifecycle (ephemeral runner API, artifact outputs, TTL)
Implement: CLI flag and launcher that isolates config and environment variables from primary harness
Implement: pluggable runner shim interface + two reference shims (local subprocess and k8s ephemeral pod)
Implement: deterministic prompt-mutation library and manifest writer
Implement: dataset sampler that emits lineage metadata and writes shards to S3 with versioned keys
Integrate: profile draft generator that consumes sandbox artifacts and posts a draft to profile-registry API
Testing: unit and integration tests, plus a staging pipeline job that runs daily against canary models
Docs: update onboarding guide, CLI docs, and add a troubleshooting playbook
